source.description: deploy sudoers grant with NOPASSWD systemctl

sink.description: deploy user can run systemctl as root without password

flow.description: sudoers policy grants the deploy user root systemctl capability

findings.description: The sudoers change lets the deploy user run /usr/bin/systemctl as root with NOPASSWD and no unit/action allowlist, so the deploy principal now has broad root service-control capability.
findings.suggested_fix: Constrain sudoers to an exact systemctl action and unit, or require a password/approval gate for privileged service operations.

notes: Policy proof: changed sudoers grant directly broadens the deploy principal's root systemctl capability.
